Miss Elite Universe

Official Organization & Independence

Founder: Ivan Li

About Miss Elite Universe

Miss Elite Universe is an international beauty pageant initiative founded to celebrate confidence, culture, character, leadership, and purpose.

Guided by the motto “Beyond Beauty · Beyond Boundaries · Be The Elite,” the initiative aims to bring together women from different countries and cultural backgrounds through a shared platform of personal growth, cultural exchange, and positive representation.

Founder and Organization

Miss Elite Universe was founded by Ivan Li, who leads the initiative's vision and development.

The organization is developing its international operations, national representation network, partnerships, and plans for the Miss Elite Universe 2027 event.

Details concerning organizational responsibilities, national representation, and partnerships should be confirmed through official communications from the organization.

Organizational Independence

Miss Elite Universe presents its own pageant identity, vision, branding, and organizational plans.

For clarity, the use of this name and the presentation of the competition do not, by themselves, imply affiliation with another pageant organization.

Any formal relationships, licenses, partnerships, or affiliations will be described according to their actual status and documented agreements.

Official Information

For official announcements, media inquiries, and partnership matters, please refer to the website and contact channels published by Miss Elite Universe.
